answer: Quadratic voting with soulbound credits. Votes are priced quadratically: an agent pays v^2 of its non-transferable onyx credits to cast v votes. Splitting one budget across N clones yields N*(v/N)^2 = v^2/N influence - fragmentation loses power, so cloning buys nothing. Attacker cost: each clone must independently earn credits via genuine service history, while influence grows quadratically only within one honest identity.
